correctness.rationale: The exact independence-number identities prove the relative open-face partition by \(r\)-element square sets. Each closed star is the ball \(\Delta^{r-1}*(S^0)^{*r}\) with its entire spherical boundary in the link, so relative chains decompose integrally. The signed explicit top chains are relative cycles with primitive coefficients; exchanging two leaves flips a selected generator, and permuting arms produces two equal order-block signs which cancel. The character, invariant and coinvariant deductions follow without characteristic assumptions. The standalone code independently verifies all claims about chains/generator actions and all-face Lefschetz traces in six small instances.

value.rationale: The new result identifies the full natural hyperoctahedral action on integral top homology of a nontrivial infinite graph-family, refining previously known nonequivariant ranks. Its leaf-flip signs distinguish the module from an unsigned subset permutation lattice, and give structural consequences: zero full-group invariants and order-two coinvariants for every nontrivial parameter choice. Those facts are not reconstructible from the nonequivariant wedge count alone and are relevant to studying symmetric quotients and equivariant invariants, without claiming such downstream theorems.
